name: Pench Tiger Camp Dining
signature_dish: Local-produce thali cooked on earthen chulha
why_it_matters: Boutique luxury-tent resort 5 minutes from Khursapar Gate (the Maharashtra-side gate famous for tiger sightings) — pure-veg Indian dining, food cooked over traditional earthen chulhas with fresh local produce. 90 minutes from Nagpur airport. The closest dining to Khursapar gate buffer.
insider_tip: Non-residents accepted by 24-hour pre-booking. Set-menu lunch + dinner (₹800-1200) is more reliable than à la carte. Filter coffee at 5am before the morning safari is the unofficial signature.
signature_address: Garra village, Khursapar Gate, Pench Tiger Reserve, Ramtek, Nagpur 441401

name: Olive Resort Sillari Restaurant
why_it_matters: Villa resort in the Sillari-Khursapar buffer, 8km from Sillari Gate and 20km from Khursapar Gate. Pool-view balcony villas, in-house restaurant serving Indian + Vidarbha. Open to non-residents for lunch + dinner with prior call. Useful for travellers staying at MTDC Sillari (no breakfast service) for paid à la carte meals.
insider_tip: Pool-view tables open 12-3pm + 7-10pm. Buffet ₹900-1200; à la carte more flexible. Carrom + snooker free for diners with kids during the safari gap 11am-3pm.
signature_address: Sillari Gate, Pench Tiger Reserve, Khursapar Sitapur, Paoni, Ramtek 441401

name: MTDC Sillari Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: MTDC Sillari is the only government accommodation at Sillari Gate from the Maharashtra side, just 500m from the gate. The in-house restaurant serves Indian + local Vidarbha cuisine at govt-fixed prices — useful as a budget non-Olive option for solo safari travellers and small families. Open 7am-10pm.
insider_tip: Walk-in lunch + dinner accepted; book a 7am breakfast slot the night before if you're doing the 6am safari from Sillari gate. Cash + UPI; cards spotty.
signature_address: MTDC Sillari Resort, Sillari, Tal. Ramtek, Nagpur 441401
